body:
A bound Query contains addresses into caller state. Builder-derived queries share an execution guard so overlapping executions fail rather than write through those addresses together; independently constructed queries can still point at the same variables, so callers must preserve ownership. Custom builders should propagate NewGuardedQuery guards, not rely on a Query struct literal. Reader composition builds per-row allocators instead, allowing reuse when custom allocators and callbacks are concurrency-safe. Neither mechanism synchronizes arbitrary caller access to destination variables.

title: Result lifetime and concurrency boundary
